cases.prompt: Generate a lighting rig for a target that uses an EffectComposer
cases.expect: Places tone mapping inside the composer chain, not at the renderer level, and says why (renderer-level tone mapping compiles out under a composer).

cases.prompt: Generate a lighting rig for a brief with style.mode: stylized
cases.expect: Confirms with the user whether a full IBL+shadow rig is wanted before generating one, rather than assuming realistic-industrial defaults for every style.
